scope: Offline geometric motion-consistency diagnosis only. GT never enters normal estimator. Full extracted range-image points, independent of facade selection/normals/native correspondence. Not a new estimator, threshold or proposed setting.
regions: right front x[3,15], other right bounds unchanged
right rear x[-12,-2], other right bounds unchanged
selection: Right box and front/rear subdivisions selected by visual inspection of committed204 full-cloud geometry. Opposite-side box is a geometric comparison region, not certified static or semantic ground truth. Same boxes for all eight endpoints; no exclusion of adverse profiles.
method: Transform current full extracted .all points by offline GT relative pose; crop previous and transformed current points to each fixed region. Evaluate symmetric nearest-point mean squared distance against previous full points for x translations from -3m to3m inclusive at0.05m spacing, plus mean of lowest80percent of pooled distances. All points retained; every profile recorded, not just minimum. Existing PCL float KDTree; original immutable PR159 feature extraction library. Translation optimum is diagnostic scene coherence, not a recovered odometry pose.
limits: Range-image sampling, cropping, partial visibility, ground leaks and GT timing/calibration can affect minima. Repeated structures can alias. A coherent profile plus terminal ablation can support a local scene-motion explanation, but cannot certify individual semantic objects or establish all remaining failure intervals/10 drift. No paper accuracy ratio or general recovery claim.
